entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis-Marie Ling Mangkhanekhoun, IVD is a Laotian prelate of the Catholic Church. A bishop since 2001, he was made a cardinal on 28 June 2017 and served as the Vicar Apostolic of Vientiane since December 2017 until December 2024. He is the first cardinal from Laos.
